runs.summary: 2 new candidates found (H.B. Fuller, Intertek), 4 status changes (Delivery Hero: pre-announcement → resolved via €13B Uber takeover)

newCandidates.note: Ancora bid $1.1-1.2B for the Building Adhesive Solutions segment (Aug 12); board rejected Aug 24 citing undervaluation and 30+ shared plants; Ancora raised to $1.2-1.4B with a Fortress financing letter (Sep 29) and is demanding a formal strategic-alternatives review. Carve-out sale rather than spinoff; management resisting.

Backfilled: board launched a strategic review Apr 14 2026 to separate Energy & Infrastructure via sale or demerger (sale-led, buyer interest 'encouraging'), targeting mid-2027; rejected three EQT take-private bids up to £58/share. Board-initiated, like Valmet.

statusChanges.change: RESOLVED VIA TAKEOVER — Uber signed a business combination agreement Jul 16 2026: €41.50/share cash, ~€13B equity, board-backed, Prosus irrevocable; 14 overlapping markets sold to SSW Partners for €1.4B; EU/Saudi review; close H2 2027. Östberg reversed his exit Sep 24 and stays through the sale. Missed by Aug/Sep runs. Now merger arb; removed from active watch.
TCIM (~4.65%) filed definitive proxy for a non-binding no-confidence vote on board/management; record date Sep 30, meeting Nov 24 2026.
Sept 14 final-approval hearing on the $7.25B Roundup settlement held; 100+ objectors; no ruling yet, expected within weeks.
Castrol/Stonepeak: ACCC and Pakistan CCP approvals in; only India CCI pending; year-end close on track.

content.recommendation: No pre-announcement → announced escalation this month, so no mandatory /market-analyst run. Optional: /market-analyst DHER to check the merger-arb spread against €41.50.

runs.summary: 0 new candidates found, 7 status changes (Solventum announced HIS separation; WEX board rejected spinoff)

statusChanges.change: ANNOUNCED — Aug 5 2026: formally announced intent to separate its Health Information Systems business ($1.4B revenue, 30+ countries, 75%+ of US hospitals), evaluating spin-off/sale/merger structures, targeting close within 12-18 months (advised by Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, Cleary Gottlieb). Directly answers Trian's April open letter. Dental remains bundled with MedSurg for now — that part of Trian's demand is still unresolved. Checklist now 7/7 on the HIS piece.

THESIS DROPPED — After the May cooperation agreement seated 3 Impactive directors and split Chair/CEO, WEX's board formally rejected the Benefits spin-off proposal (and a related mega-grant ask) after its strategic review, citing lower standalone growth, customer-concentration risk, and reduced access to low-cost capital. Removed from active watch — no near-term catalyst.

Missouri final-approval hearing for the $7.25B Roundup class settlement, originally Aug 19, postponed twice — first to Sept 10 by joint motion, then formally rescheduled by the court to Sept 14 2026 to process opt-out revocation requests. Still no formal separation announcement from Anderson.

TheFork sale advanced from put-option (June 15) to a signed Equity Purchase Agreement with American Express Travel, Aug 2 2026, $700M cash subject to adjustments. Not yet closed. Starboard's broader push for a full company sale/board majority still unresolved.

ESCALATING FURTHER — TOMS Capital (TCIM) filed DFAN14A proxy materials in early Aug 2026, moving from private pressure to a public push including a call for a shareholder vote of no confidence. Combined economic exposure across TOMS/TCIM funds now ~5.7M shares (~4.5%+). Informal takeover interest (incl. Principal Financial) still circling but no talks confirmed.
Castrol/Stonepeak sale (~$10B EV) cleared EU (unconditional) and China SAMR antitrust; Australia (ACCC) and India (CCI) reviews still pending. Deal remains on track for a year-end 2026 close.

Aspex built its stake to ~15% (from ~9.2%), including a further 5% purchase from Prosus for €335M in May, reportedly under EU pressure on Prosus to reduce its holding. CEO search targeting a decision by end of 2026 (hard cutoff Mar 31 2027).

content.recommendation: Run /market-analyst SOLV (Solventum) — Trian's HIS separation demand was answered within 4 months of the open letter; worth modeling the surviving MedSurg+Dental entity and the HIS separation structures once terms firm up.
